import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, DATABASES={}, INSTALLED_APPS=[])
django.setup()
from django.db.models import CharField
from django.db.models.lookups import Lookup

class TempUpper(Lookup):
    lookup_name = "tempupper"

CharField.register_lookup(TempUpper)
print("after register:", CharField.get_lookups().get("tempupper") is TempUpper)
CharField._unregister_lookup(TempUpper)
print("after unregister:", CharField.get_lookups().get("tempupper"))
# cache must be empty again after unregister
print("cache empty:", CharField.get_lookups.cache_info().currsize == 0)
# re-register still works (cache rebuilds)
CharField.register_lookup(TempUpper)
print("re-register:", CharField.get_lookups().get("tempupper") is TempUpper)
CharField._unregister_lookup(TempUpper, "tempupper")
print("unregister by name:", CharField.get_lookups().get("tempupper"))
EOF
